planets.name: K2-417 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-417 with a 6.54-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: K2-417 b was found in 2023 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-417. Its orbit and size follow Incha et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
